kyoto_monaka_stand.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan dishes such as outside skirt and corn butter may suit; fried rice, kara-age and tempura are on the menu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_monaka_stand.vegan_detail: Not vegan: teppan meat and seafood dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_monaka_stand.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). Children under junior-high age and pets: call ahead; online-only bookings may be refused (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 36 seats, counter included (Tabelog; August 2025 review). On a narrow bar street near Karasuma, 2 min from Hankyu Karasuma exit 26 or Shijo exit 2 (Tabelog; February 2026 review).
kyoto_monaka_stand.notes: [Teppan bar · Shijo-Karasuma] A lively, modern teppan baru on a bar alley by Karasuma: outside skirt, Kujo-negi pork rolls, Kyoto touches like nama-fu and hamo, and an all-you-can-drink option with a la carte. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: A teppanyaki-led bar with a wide drinks list (2025–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan outside skirt; Kujo-negi pork rolls.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 pair ordered nama-fu and hamo tempura before realising the place specialises in teppan, then tried the Kujo-negi pork rolls.
A March 2026 visitor, turned away on an earlier Friday because it was full, finally got in for outside skirt and spring rolls.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: もなかスタンド、バル・鉄板焼き、中京区観音堂町468 1F、阪急烏丸駅26番出口・地下鉄四条駅2番出口から徒歩2分、毎日 17:00〜24:00、休みは変わる場合あり、子供とペットは電話で相談、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、36席。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 鉄板焼きのバル、ハラミ、生春巻き、Kujo ねぎの豚バラ巻き、生麩、hamo の揚げ物、ガーリックライス、アラカルトの飲み放題。

cultural_comfort.note: Call ahead with children or pets (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_manryo_furukawacho.gf_detail: Ask. Home-style obanzai and bentos with soy and dashi; curry and udon are wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_manryo_furukawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bentos with a meat or fish main, such as braised mackerel (August 2026 review).
kyoto_manryo_furukawacho.hours_raw: Hours not given on Tabelog. Open at lunch, including on a Sunday and during Obon (August 2025 and August 2026 reviews). Regulars drink at the counter (August 2025 review). No e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter seats; sake and shochu (Tabelog). In the middle of the Furukawa-cho arcade, near Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_manryo_furukawacho.notes: [Obanzai · Furukawa-cho] A neighbourhood obanzai counter in the old Furukawa-cho arcade: home-style bento lunches with a fish or meat main and a sweet or coffee to finish, and regulars with a drink at the counter. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: A community-focused obanzai shop in the Furukawa-cho arcade (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family, out during Obon, chose shaved ice for the children as the after-lunch treat and got tea sweets too.
An August 2025 visitor found it open on a Sunday when most of the arcade was shut, with regulars drinking at the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 万両、食堂・喫茶店・惣菜、東山区の商店街の中ほど、地下鉄東山駅から147m、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター席、日本酒・焼酎。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 地域のおばんざいの店、肉か魚を選べる弁当 (サバの煮付けなど)、食後にコーヒー・紅茶・かき氷、カレー、冷たいうどん、カウンターで飲む常連。

cultural_comfort.note: A local neighbourhood counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and the arcade site; reviews dated August 2025 and August 2026.

kyoto_kanmidokoro_noan.gf_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi, zenzai with mochi, anmitsu and soft serve (2025–26 reviews); ingredients not stated.
kyoto_kanmidokoro_noan.vegan_detail: Ask. Warabi mochi with kinako and kuromitsu and zenzai (2025 reviews) may suit; soft serve and parfaits contain dairy.
kyoto_kanmidokoro_noan.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–17:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). Cards, Suica and QR (Tabelog). 10 seats inside plus outdoor seats under a red parasol on a hearth-style terrace; non-smoking (Tabelog; November 2025 reviews). By Entoku-in and the Kodaiji museum on Shimogawara (Tabelog; November 2025 reviews).
kyoto_kanmidokoro_noan.notes: [Japanese sweets · Kodaiji] A small tea stop by Entoku-in for zenzai with toasted mochi, real-bracken warabi mochi with kuromitsu, matcha soft serve and shaved ice in summer, with outdoor seats under a red parasol. Under ¥1,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 November 2021 (Tabelog). A sign at the shop reads "Kodaiji's favourite" (May 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Zenzai with toasted mochi; warabi mochi.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 couple, back from Entoku-in, sat under a red parasol on red stools for very soft warabi mochi.
A March 2026 visitor stopped for matcha soft serve after paying respects at Sanmen Daikokuten.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 甘味処 乃あん、甘味処、東山区、高台寺の近く、毎日 10:00〜17:00、予約不可、カード・Suica・QR 可、10席、禁煙、2021年11月1日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 圓徳院と高台寺の美術館のそば、Tanba の大納言と Hamanaka の米の餅のぜんざい、本わらび粉と黒蜜のわらび餅、煎茶つき、抹茶とミルクのソフトクリーム、白玉とあずきのパフェ、夏はかき氷、屋外の赤い傘の席。

cultural_comfort.note: Many sightseers; outdoor seats (2025 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_bar_sasa_higashiyama.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bar; drinks include beer and whisky, and the snacks are not described as gluten-free (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bar_sasa_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Ask. Gin and tonics with fruit, wine and spirits (2025–26 reviews); food is not described.
kyoto_bar_sasa_higashiyama.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday and the third Tuesday (Tabelog). 「チャージ有り」 — a cover charge applies (Tabelog); it was ¥1,000 in a January 2023 review. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). About five counter seats and tables, behind a glass front you can see into from the street (January 2026; 2024 reviews). On the ground floor of the small hotel 東山四季花木, open to hotel guests and passers-by alike (November 2025), near Higashiyama Station.
kyoto_bar_sasa_higashiyama.notes: [Bar · Higashiyama] A calm, glass-fronted bar of wood and stone on the ground floor of the small hotel 東山四季花木 near Higashiyama Station, open to all: seasonal fruit gin and tonics, a sommelier’s wine list and a chatty master. Cover charge. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: the bar of the eight-room hotel 東山四季花木, facing the street and open to non-guests (November 2025, January 2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor tried two of the season’s gin and tonics — watermelon and sweet orange — and lost track of time talking with the master.
A November 2025 wine expert ordered a plain gin and tonic and judged the bar’s distance from the city’s bustle just right for the end of a Kyoto day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、東山区今小路町85-1 東山四季花木 1F、火〜日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、月曜と第3火曜休み、チャージ有り、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年6月、英語): ホテルの1階のバーだが宿泊客以外も入れる、ガラス張りで外から見える、ソムリエのマスター、季節の果物のジントニック (すいか、スイートオレンジ)、ワイン、スパークリングワイン、レモンサワー、カウンター約5席とテーブル。2023年1月の口コミではチャージ1,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: A hotel bar with many overseas guests (January 2026); easy to walk in alone. Cover charge applies.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_furenchibado_nijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta, quiche, tarte flambée and braised dishes (2014–26 reviews).
kyoto_furenchibado_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: red-wine-braised meat, uni pasta, tripe, venison (2017–26 reviews).
kyoto_furenchibado_nijo.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Thursday and other irregular days — check before going (Tabelog). 「お席代200円、ドリンクのご注文がない場合にはサービス料10％を頂く場合がございます。」 — a ¥200 seat charge, and a 10% service charge may apply if no drink is ordered (Tabelog). One person cooks and serves, so dishes take time (October 2026). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats, mostly at the counter (Tabelog). Ground floor of an apartment building on Nijo-dori between the Imperial Palace and City Hall (October 2026).
kyoto_furenchibado_nijo.notes: [French bistro & wine · Nijo-dori] A small, quiet French bistro on Nijo-dori near City Hall, run single-handed: classic dishes such as red-wine-braised meat and uni pasta with a broad, classic wine-by-the-glass list. Unhurried service; ¥200 seat charge. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who cooks and serves alone (October 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a French bistro and wine bar on Nijo-dori, open since 2014 (2014 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Classic bistro dishes; wines by the glass.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor found the owner running the room alone, with glasses of classic red, white and sparkling from about ¥850 to ¥2,000 and more suggested on request.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・ビストロ・ワインバー、中京区晴明町674 ヴァインオークニック 1F、月火水金土日・祝日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、木曜・不定休、お席代200円、ドリンクのご注文がない場合はサービス料10％の場合あり、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、15席。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主が一人で料理とサービス、うにのパスタ、赤ワイン煮込み、グラスワイン約850〜2,000円 (クラシック寄り)、シェリーや甘口ワインも、二条通、御所と市役所の間。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a drink (the 10% service charge may apply without one); one person runs the room, so allow time. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kamanza_ninenzaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: udon, soba in soy-based broth, tempura, nama-fu (wheat gluten) (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_kamanza_ninenzaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck soba, chicken udon, herring soba, shrimp tempura, dashi throughout (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kamanza_ninenzaka.hours_raw: From 11:00; closing time and closed days not fixed (Tabelog). Busy at lunch, with waits of 20–30 minutes on weekends in the past (2023 reviews); quick turnover (May 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). 70 seats, with tatami (Tabelog; May 2025). On Ninenzaka between Kodaiji and Kiyomizu-dera; takeaway items too (shop site).
kyoto_kamanza_ninenzaka.notes: [Yuba & noodles · Ninenzaka] A large, approachable noodle house on the stone-paved Ninenzaka: yuba sashimi, duck soba with yuba, seasonal udon and tempura with Kyoto yuba, nama-fu and tofu, in rooms with tatami. Busy at lunch; hours vary.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site: a restaurant of Kyoto yuba, nama-fu and tofu with tempura, noodles and rice bowls, run by 釜座有限会社 on Ninenzaka (kamanza.co.jp).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba sashimi; duck soba with yuba.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 group tried the winter fried-mochi mizore udon with tororo kombu and grated daikon, plus chicken udon, herring soba and zaru udon.
An April 2026 visitor, put off by the pricier-looking places along Ninenzaka, found this one approachable and had duck soba with yuba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 釜座有限会社、湯葉・生麩・豆腐などの京の食材と天ぷら・麺類・丼類、持ち帰りも、東山区高台寺南門通下河原東入桝屋町363-12。食べログ: 甘味処・喫茶、11:00〜 (閉店時刻と定休日は不定)、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・電子マネー可、70席。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年4月、英語): 湯葉の刺身、ざるうどん、鴨そばと湯葉、冬の揚げ餅のみぞれうどん (とろろ昆布) 1,600円、かしわうどん、にしんそば、座敷、二年坂。

cultural_comfort.note: Expect a short wait at lunch in busy seasons. No English evidence found in 2025–26 reviews.

kyoto_taruhi_kawabata_nijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, karaage, oden and soy-seasoned Kyoto dishes (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_taruhi_kawabata_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, hamo, sea bream, dashi throughout (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_taruhi_kawabata_nijo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–22:30; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Usually nearly full; book by phone (June and August 2026). Cards (AMEX only); no e-money (Tabelog). 25 seats: 10 at the counter, 15 at tables (Tabelog). A few minutes east of Kawaramachi-Nijo across the Kamogawa, about five minutes from Sanjo Keihan (2022 and 2024 reviews).
kyoto_taruhi_kawabata_nijo.notes: [Izakaya · Kawabata-Nijo] A small, usually full izakaya near Kawabata-Nijo run by a couple: gently seasoned Kyoto dishes — sashimi, hamo in summer, sweet-sea-bream karaage — and an unusually long list of fruit liqueurs alongside sake. Book by phone; closed Wednesday. AMEX is the only card.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a Japanese izakaya near Kawabata-Nijo, opened during the pandemic and first known for lunch (2022 review), now dinner only (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner who booked by phone found the restaurant nearly full and had never seen such a range of fruit liqueurs.
An August 2026 first-night visitor took the counter for sashimi, sweet-sea-bream karaage and hamo tempura with three kinds of sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、左京区難波町216、月火木金土日18:00〜22:30、水曜休み、カード (AMEX) 可、電子マネー不可、25席 (カウンター10・テーブル15)。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年8月、英語): 夫婦で営む、京風のやさしい味、季節の料理、手頃な値段、刺身の盛り合わせ、甘鯛の唐揚げ、鱧の天ぷら、焼き鱧、果実酒が豊富、日本酒や焼酎も、いつもほぼ満席、電話で予約、京阪三条から徒歩約5分。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; bring cash or AMEX. No English evidence found.

kyoto_wine_highball_tsuchiya.gf_detail: Ask. A bar of wine, whisky and sherry; home-cooked food such as omurice, a burger and a cream-cheese pâté is not described for gluten (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_wine_highball_tsuchiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks-led; the vegetable jelly may suit, but most food includes egg, meat or cheese (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_wine_highball_tsuchiya.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 19:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); Monday 19:00–1:00, drinks only (no food); closed Sunday and one Monday a month, so Monday is left out of the hours (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥300 (Tabelog original チャージ料 ￥300-). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables; non-smoking, with a smoking area outside; wheelchair access (Tabelog). A wood-lined, café-like room on a quiet residential street, 1 min walk from Gojo Stn exit 8 (Tabelog; February 2019).
kyoto_wine_highball_tsuchiya.notes: [Bar · by Gojo Stn, late] A calm, wood-lined bar near Gojo station with a big range of wines, rare whiskies and sherry, and real home cooking — omurice, burgers, pâté — until late. ¥300 cover. Closed Sunday; Mondays drinks only.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a bar where the master, deeply passionate about drinks, picks whiskies and wines to suit (February 2019; August 2024), and the madam makes all the food by hand (September 2024); it also hosts small concerts (December 2025).

anecdotes.text: A hungry September 2024 regular phoned before 11 p.m. to check the omurice was still on, then paired it with a stronger whisky highball.
A February 2019 first-timer, worried on a dark residential street, spotted the bright sign and found a welcoming wooden room.
A December 2025 guest came for a mini concert and enjoyed vegetable jelly, pâté and a hearty burger.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー・ワインバー、下京区諏訪町通六条上ル上柳町220-5、五条駅8番出口から徒歩1分、火〜土 19:00〜25:00 (L.O.24:30)、月 19:00〜25:00 (飲み物のみ)、日曜と月に1回の月曜休み、予約可、チャージ料 ￥300-、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、車いす可。口コミ (2016年3月〜2025年12月、英語): 木の落ち着いた店内、ワイン、珍しいウイスキー、シェリー、ハイボール、お酒への情熱の深いマスター、料理はすべてマダムの手作り (オムライス1,100円、野菜のゼリー、クリームチーズのパテ、卵と牛肉のパティのバーガー)、お通しに和三盆、ミニコンサート (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥300 cover; Mondays drinks only; cards accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through December 2025.

kyoto_obanzai_ichiyoshi.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and hamo yubiki may suit, but suppon and botan nabe broths, nuta and obanzai use soy, and tempura is battered (2021–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_obanzai_ichiyoshi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soft-shell turtle, wild boar, fish and dashi-based obanzai (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_obanzai_ichiyoshi.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday 17:00–24:00; Wednesday closed but open by reservation (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog original なし). Cash only — no cards (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Just north of Shijo on Aburakoji-dori; 7 min walk from Shijo/Karasuma or Omiya Stn (Tabelog; March 2024).
kyoto_obanzai_ichiyoshi.notes: [Obanzai and suppon · Aburakoji-Shijo, cash only] A small counter where a ryotei-trained chef serves generous appetisers, seasonal sashimi and hamo, and rich suppon or wild-boar hot pots, with sake and shochu. Smoking allowed. Wednesdays by booking only.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: chef Ichinose trained at a well-known restaurant in Arashiyama and served as head chef in Gion before running this counter (September 2022); a dog-loving, charming host (March–July 2024) whose suppon draws first-timers (March 2024; May 2026).

anecdotes.text: A September 2022 visitor flown in from Iwate could not have the nabe that night, so chef Ichinose sent the guest off with a glass of habu sake.
A March 2024 solo diner, whose friends shied away from turtle, finally tried suppon nabe here and recommends it for first-timers.
A July 2024 visitor found the hamo sold out and got eel sashimi instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: すっぽん・日本料理・居酒屋、京都市油小路四条上ル藤本町555-3、四条駅・烏丸駅や大宮駅から徒歩7分、木〜火 17:00〜24:00、水曜休み (予約で営業)、予約可、サービス料なし、カード不可、カウンター10席、喫煙可。口コミ (2021年11月〜2026年7月、英語): 嵐山の名店で修業し祇園で料理長を務めた Ichinose さん (2022年9月)、すっぽん鍋、ぼたん鍋 (いのしし)、豪華なお通し3品、たこ・帆立・鱧・白いか・京都牛の刺身、鱧の湯引き、帆立のぬた、とうもろこしの天ぷら、栗と銀杏の揚げ物、生ハムといちじく、筍、うなぎの刺身、犬好きの店主。

kyoto_coffee_ten_ishihara.notes: [Kissa · near Matsubara shopping street, cash only] A quiet, nostalgic machiya coffee shop with blue chairs, where regulars just say “please” and the master brews each cup — with butter or cheese toast for a slow break. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a long-standing local kissa in a townhouse, where the master brews each coffee with care and regulars from the neighbourhood come in the mornings (2016–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An April 2022 visitor watched regulars order by just saying “please”, and remembered being bored at a café like this as a child.
A January 2024 guest loved the café au lait and the blue chairs.
A January 2026 visitor with time to spare found a nostalgic yet clean, dignified room for a ¥500 blend.

kyoto_kyo_ebisuya_maguro.gf_detail: Ask. Tuna on vinegared rice may suit, but the marinade and special sauce likely use soy; curry udon is wheat (2023–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_kyo_ebisuya_maguro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tuna rice bowls (2023–2026 reviews).

Counter seats; calm room, good for solo lunch (January 2023; July 2026). Ebisugawa-dori near Takakura, next to a crêperie; 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn.
kyoto_kyo_ebisuya_maguro.notes: [Tuna bowls · Ebisugawa-Takakura, cash only] A calm little counter for tuna donburi with fish from Shimizu port: marinated akami, fatty bintoro or negitoro on vinegared rice, with kasu-jiru or curry udon sets. Great value for a solo lunch. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a small tuna-bowl shop on Ebisugawa-dori, using tuna sent direct from Shimizu port (April 2026), with regulars returning year after year for the same bowl (October 2024; July 2025).

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 regular returned a year later and ordered the same bowl again, this time with a pumpkin salad on the side.
A July 2025 diner came back after a first visit with a friend in April, hooked on how gently the tuna pairs with the vinegared rice.
A January 2023 diner went half-and-half with bintoro to keep the bowl from being one-note.

kyoto_flammes_honnojicho.gf_detail: Ask. Courses and à la carte with pasta, game, Omi beef, cakes and crème brûlée; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_flammes_honnojicho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: venison, wild boar, Omi beef, fish; the amuse uses bonito jelly (2026 reviews).
kyoto_flammes_honnojicho.hours_raw: Wednesday–Saturday café 13:30–17:30 and dinner 18:00–23:00; Sunday lunch 11:30–15:00 (last orders 14:00), café 13:30–17:30 and dinner 18:00–23:00; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). Amuse charge ¥600 incl. tax (Tabelog, original 600円（アミューズ代として、税込み）). Cards (Tabelog). A counter with a fireplace in front of every seat, plus tables (May and August 2026). Opened 30 April 2026 (May 2026). A walk from the station (October 2026).
kyoto_flammes_honnojicho.notes: [Bistro · Nakagyo, fireplace counter, opened 2026] A stylish new bistro-café where every counter seat faces a fireplace: Kyoto-vegetable amuse, game such as Kyoto venison and Rakuhoku wild boar, Omi beef, pasta and desserts, with craft beer, sake and wine; café hours and seasonal afternoon teas. ¥600 amuse charge. Closed Monday and Tuesday. Flagged: operator 新烏丸株式会社.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 30 April 2026 (May 2026 review). The receipt invoice number on Tabelog belongs to 新烏丸株式会社 (上京区). No other shop of the company was found.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a third solo visit paired a gold-leafed fish carpaccio with URAMOTO sake and Chardonnay.
An October 2026 diner chose Kyoto venison over Omi beef on the autumn course and urged others to do the same.

kyoto_sakaba_light_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken sashimi with ponzu, fried wings, kara-age, mackerel sushi, fried fish cake; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakaba_light_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: black Satsuma chicken (raw and cooked), fish and seafood (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakaba_light_shijo.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). 42 seats: a counter and standing bar on the first floor, tables upstairs (Tabelog; March 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Popular dishes sell out early in the evening; often fully booked (March and July 2026). Opened 29 April 2025 (Tabelog). 5 min on foot from Shijo and Omiya stations (Tabelog). Raw chicken (torisashi, liver sashimi) is on the menu.
kyoto_sakaba_light_shijo.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo toward Omiya, Kagoshima chicken] A bright, stylish two-floor izakaya on Shijo-dori: Kagoshima black Satsuma chicken served raw as sashimi and “paccio”, or as sweet-spicy fried wings, fish like kibinago and mackerel sushi, and playful plates with charcoal highballs and craft shochu. Counter and standing bar downstairs; book or come early. Flagged: operator 有限会社起福.

chef_bio.background: The shop says its cooks trained at Arashiyama Kichijo and Kyoto Ito (Tabelog’s English spelling) (Tabelog). The receipt invoice number belongs to 有限会社起福 (中京区); Tabelog also lists a “Karaoke Sakaba Light” and “SAKASALIGHT SANDWICHES”, which no source links to this shop.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 business traveller slipped out of the hotel for a solo nightcap at the counter and tried the jet-black bamboo-charcoal highball.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒場らいと、立ち飲み・鶏料理・海鮮、下京区石井筒町518、毎日 17:00〜24:00、2025年4月29日オープン、カード可、42席、1階はカウンターと立ち飲み・2階はテーブル、禁煙、鹿児島直送の黒さつま鶏・旬の魚・野菜、名物は自家製ごま油ポン酢の鶏のパッチョ、甘辛の手羽先唐揚げ、鹿児島限定の焼酎のソーダ割り、Arashiyama Kichijo や Kyoto Ito (食べログ英語版の表記) で修業した料理人。適格請求書: 有限会社起福 (中京区)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 白レバー刺し528円、卵黄の肉豆腐748円、焼き鯖寿司1貫495円、塩麹にんにくの唐揚げ770円、ビール605円、きびなご、インカのめざめのフライドポテト、akaten (赤いすり身の揚げ物)、竹炭ハイボール、もも刺しのもみじおろしポン酢、ヤングコーンの焼き、タコとアボカドのキムチ748円、自家製バスクチーズケーキ660円、親子丼、人気の品は早く売り切れる。

kyoto_hanhan_shogoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Japanese omakase with tempura, soy-marinated and miso-marinated dishes and sauces (2024–2025 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_hanhan_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses are built half on meat — tripe, beef, pork, chicken broth — and half on vegetables (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanhan_shogoin.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue and Thu 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00); Wed, Fri and Sat 12:30–15:00 (L.O. 13:00) and 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday and Monday. Reservations only. Dinner omakase about ¥20,000 (December 2024 – February 2025); lunch is rice dishes built on vegetables, chicken and pork (March 2025). No service charge (「無し」, Tabelog Japanese original). 8 seats around a large shared table; private hire on request. Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible. Cards and QR codes; no e-money. In Shogoin, 4 min from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_hanhan_shogoin.notes: [Japanese omakase · Shogoin, meat and vegetables "half and half"] A calm eight-seat table where a kaiseki-trained chef and his partner serve a charcoal-scented omakase balancing beef, pork and tripe with seasonal vegetables. Dinner about ¥20,000, lunch rice dishes on some days. Reservations only. Closed Sun and Mon.

chef_bio.background: A February 2025 reviewer calls it a restaurant run by a couple he knows, the head chef coming from kaiseki and cooking inventive Japanese food around his love of meat over charcoal; a December 2024 diner heard the chef trained at several places, including time at "Kiu", and that the room sometimes runs as a bar later in the evening. An April–June 2026 regular finds the staff flexible and orders extra dishes, meat and fish, every visit.

anecdotes.text: December 2024: "This restaurant offers a course featuring an equal balance of vegetables and meat, with no fish involved… While the meat dishes are abundant, they're well-balanced, so it's not overwhelming."
February 2025: "A restaurant run by a couple I know. The head chef, who comes from a kaiseki background, creates innovative Japanese dishes incorporating his love for meats."
February 2025: "The salad made with watercress picked by the chef himself… was simple yet highlighted the freshness beautifully."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 半々、日本料理、左京区聖護院東寺領町7-2、京阪神宮丸太町から徒歩4分、火・木18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.20:00)、水・金・土12:30〜15:00 (L.O.13:00)・18:00〜22:00、日・月休み、完全予約制、サービス料「無し」、8席、禁煙、車いす可、カード・QR可。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年6月、英語): 夫婦で営む (2025年2月)、懐石出身の料理人、肉と野菜が半々のおまかせ約20,000円、ハチノスの酢味噌、聖護院大根の天ぷらとブレザオラ、鶏と昆布のだし、Shiina牛のサーロイン、成牛の牛肉の炭火焼き、肉のタルタルの海苔巻き、TOKYO Xのしゃぶしゃぶ、塩ミルクのアイス、昼は野菜・鶏・豚のご飯もの、夜遅くはバーになる日もあるとの声、2026年は魚も。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only; one shared table; omakase.

kyoto_kenzo_oike.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: dashi- and soy-based dishes, nagaimo tempura, fried dishes, nama-fu, yakisoba and yatsuhashi (2019–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_kenzo_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, Tanba chicken, liver and heart, wings, clam chowder, and dashi in most dishes (2019–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kenzo_oike.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–25:00; closed Sunday. Reservations taken. SMOKING ALLOWED (Tabelog). Cards. 31 seats: counter, tatami and sunken seating, private rooms for 4 to 30; private hire 20–50. Mobile ordering (October 2023). On the ground floor of the Octopia Oike building, a few minutes from Karasuma Oike.
kyoto_kenzo_oike.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma Oike, dashi and sake till 1 am] A warm, stylish izakaya where everything starts from good dashi: mochi in broth as the starter, fresh sashimi, Tanba chicken, yuba clam chowder, and yatsuhashi with cheese and honey. About ¥4,000–8,000. Private rooms. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a friendly, chatty owner with a "wild yet gentle" personality who writes the menu by hand (2022), regulars of seven-plus years, and more overseas guests since 2023. A March 2019 reviewer mentions sake connected to the "Shoutoku" brewery. Criticisms: a long wait for the salt-grilled chicken (December 2023) and, in 2017, pricey and average.

anecdotes.text: February 2025: "The first dish served was tsukidashi, consisting of freshly made mochi soaked in dashi… Just from this, I felt, 'This place has great potential!'"
November 2022: "The owner is friendly and chatty, and I highly recommend sitting at the counter! The simmered lotus root and the fried nagaimo are dishes I crave time and time again."
December 2023: "The 'Tanba Chicken Salt Grilled' took a while to arrive, and I started to wonder if it had been forgotten."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Ken蔵、居酒屋・日本料理・海鮮、中京区衣棚押小路下ル下妙覚寺町192-1 オクトピア御池1F、烏丸御池から219m、月〜土18:00〜25:00、日曜休み、予約可、喫煙可、カード可、31席、個室 (4〜30名)、カウンター・座敷・掘りごたつ。口コミ (2017年12月〜2026年4月、英語): だしがおいしい居酒屋、お通しはつきたての餅のだし浸し、刺身の盛り合わせ (つぶ貝、生湯葉、かつお、鯛、ひらめ、たこ)、丹波の鶏の塩焼き、鶏のたたき、れんこんの煮物、長芋の揚げ物、生麩田楽、湯葉のクラムチャウダー、京風焼きそば、チーズとはちみつの八ッ橋、八ッ橋アイス、気さくでよく話す店主、モバイルオーダー (2023年10月)、塩焼きが遅かったとの声 (2023年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Mobile ordering; counter seats recommended; smoking allowed.

kyoto_yohaku_store.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: snacks include soy-simmered beef tendon and fried tofu, nanban-zuke chicken and Nara-zuke butter on biscuits (2023–2025 reviews); craft beer is wheat/barley-based.
kyoto_yohaku_store.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the snacks are fish, beef, chicken and sake-lees oden from the sister izakaya (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_yohaku_store.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:00–20:00, irregular closures. No reservations. A sake shop with a standing counter for about 4–6; bottles to buy. Sake 60 ml from ¥500, 120 ml from ¥900; wine 60 ml from ¥600 (September 2024). No cards or e-money; QR codes accepted. Snacks of about ¥500 come from the sister izakaya 両川 next door and 澄吉. On Oshikoji-dori west of Muromachi, 4 min from Karasuma Oike.
kyoto_yohaku_store.notes: [Standing sake bar · Oshikoji-Muromachi, morning sake with izakaya snacks] A pocket-sized sake shop with a stand-up counter, open from 10 am: try owner-picked sake by the 60 ml (from ¥500) with ¥500 plates from the acclaimed izakaya 両川 next door, then buy a bottle. About ¥1,500. QR payment, no cards.

chef_bio.background: Opened in November 2023 as a sake shop and standing bar by the people behind the izakaya 両川 (kyoto_ryosen, next door) and 澄吉 (kyoto_sumiyoshi_karasuma_oike), and described as their "antenna shop" (2024–2025 reviews). A September 2024 reviewer met the woman who runs it alone, chooses every sake herself after tasting and visits breweries on her days off.
chef_bio.philosophy: A single well-chosen bottle rather than a huge range (September 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Owner-picked sake by the glass; izakaya snacks.

anecdotes.text: September 2024: "The sake selection is carefully chosen by the woman running the store, as she has personally tasted everything, and on her days off, she even visits sake breweries."
December 2023: "We had sashimi of sawara, stewed wagyu tendon with thick fried tofu, and oden with sake lees… all of which were affordable and incredibly tasty."
May 2025: "I was only shown the bottled beers, even though it seemed like there were two TAP beers available… It was a bit disappointing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 余白Store、立ち飲み、中京区押小路通室町西入蛸薬師町293、烏丸御池から徒歩4分、毎日10:00〜20:00、不定休、予約不可、6席、カード・電子マネー不可、QR可、日本酒・ワインにこだわる。口コミ (2023年12月〜2025年12月、英語): 2023年11月開店、隣の居酒屋「両川」と「澄吉」の姉妹店 (アンテナショップ) の酒屋の角打ち、日本酒60mlで500円から、120mlで900円から、ワイン60mlで600円から、Wood Mill Breweryのクラフトビール、両川と澄吉のおつまみ約500円 (松阪牛のすじと厚揚げの煮込み、鰆の刺身、手羽と牡蠣の煮込み、Kibi鶏の南蛮漬け、酒粕のおでん)、店主手作りの奈良漬けバター、ひとりで店を切り盛りする女性が酒を選び蔵元も訪ねる (2024年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing only, a few people at a time; staff help choose sake.

kyoto_scene_factory_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: croissants with cream, cheese cream, bacon or meringue, and milk-based lattes (2024–2026 reviews); no plant milk is mentioned.

kyoto_scene_factory_coffee.notes: [Café · Gojo-Shinmachi, roaster café with fruit croissants] A quiet, spacious white café from the roaster SCENE FACTORY: fruity single coffees and smooth lattes with seasonal croissant sandwiches — strawberry, peach, chestnut — about ¥1,570 with a drink. Good for working; many overseas guests. Open daily from 8:30.

chef_bio.background: The café of SCENE FACTORY COFFEE ROASTERS, opened 12 December 2022 on the ground floor of a hotel at Shinmachi-Gojo (2025–2026 reviews); the hotel is not named. chef_bio.philosophy: Coffee blends designed for different everyday "scenes" (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "The croissant was wonderfully flaky, and the cheese cream was rich and decadent. It paired perfectly with the juicy peach."
October 2025: "Inspired by Mont Blanc, featuring chestnut paste and fresh cream, topped with meringue resembling snow-capped mountains, and accented with cassis sauce."
April 2026: "The carrot cake had a thin layer of cream on top, which left me feeling a bit unsatisfied… The service was a bit dry."

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 guest who came for yakitori learned there were no skewers any more and stayed for side dishes and beer.
A July 2025 business traveller found the closing keema curry the highlight — then learned it is a curry shop at lunch.
A March 2026 pair chose liver as the main of a ¥5,000 free-drink course.

kyoto_gion_asakura_furunishi.notes: [Italian · north Gion near Sanjo, Italian-kaiseki counter] An eight-seat counter in a quiet alley serving Italian food with a kaiseki touch, cooked to your taste — sea-urchin cream pasta, escargot, raclette-topped meat — with wine pairings. chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Indian restaurant opened 15 July 2026 at Gojo-Karasuma; a sister shop operates in Saiin (Tabelog search).

kyoto_tiem_an_huong_viet.notes: [Vietnamese · Karasuma Oike] A long-running Vietnamese restaurant (since 2000) near Karasuma Oike serving dinner courses only, shaped to your tastes from ingredients the owner sources on regular trips to Vietnam: herbs, fermented sauces, soft-shell crab, house tofu, herbal hot pots. roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who travels to Vietnam several times a year for ingredients and research (May 2025)

kyoto_the_nook_kyoto.notes: [Steamer café & izakaya · Higashioji] A family-run concrete-and-wood café opened June 2026 on Higashioji near Higashiyama Station: colourful lunch plates and bamboo-steamer plates of chicken, roast pork and vegetables with steamed focaccia, steamer pasta such as white-miso carbonara, and steamer dishes with drinks at night. kyoto_banboo_higashiyama_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. The starter is a shabu-shabu pot in dashi with tororo kombu; sashimi and grilled dishes, fried horse mackerel (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_banboo_higashiyama_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and pork shabu-shabu, sashimi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_banboo_higashiyama_sanjo.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00; Sun 16:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Starter charge ¥700 — a small shabu-shabu pot (Tabelog Japanese original 「お通し700円（税込）」; 2026 reviews). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 32 seats with a tatami room at the back (Tabelog; August 2026 review). By Higashiyama Stn exit 2 on Sanjo-dori; moved next door from its old site (Tabelog; July 2025 review).
kyoto_banboo_higashiyama_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Higashiyama-Sanjo] A lively, often-full izakaya by Higashiyama Stn where every meal starts with a little shabu-shabu pot of seasonal fish, and sake comes in bamboo tubes; a handy stop after shows at ROHM Theatre. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: The main shop of 株式会社晩boo, which also runs a shop at Kojinguchi (careermap). A diner returning after about ten years found it had moved next door (July 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes change with the seasons (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Shabu-shabu pot starter; sake in bamboo.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular built the starter pot of sea bream into a full meal, adding shellfish, mushrooms and finally pork shabu-shabu.
A July 2026 group, usually here after shows at ROHM Theatre but often turned away, finally got a table for a birthday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 晩boo 東山三条本店、居酒屋・魚介料理・しゃぶしゃぶ、東山区東山三条東入ル南側、地下鉄東山駅2番出口すぐ、月〜土・祝日 17:00〜23:00、日 16:00〜23:00、不定休、お通し700円、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、32席、季節で変わる料理。キャリアマップ: 株式会社晩boo、東山三条店と荒神口店。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): お通しは紙鍋の鯛しゃぶ (とろろ昆布と出汁)、竹筒の冷酒、刺身、焼き物、アジフライ、奥の座敷。

kyoto_bunny_b_sakaimachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sandwiches, burgers and hot dogs on bread (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bunny_b_sakaimachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and fish-fry sandwiches, burgers and hot dogs (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_bunny_b_sakaimachi.hours_raw: From 9:45; closed Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Sundays — so open Thursday to Saturday; closing time not given; hours may change (Tabelog). The former evening bar hours have ended (July 2025 review). Takeaway; a few seats (Tabelog; June 2026 review). PayPay and cards; no e-money (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi north of Oshikoji, about 370 m from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_bunny_b_sakaimachi.notes: [Sandwiches & burgers · Sakaimachi] A tiny Tiffany-blue shop run by two sisters near Karasuma-Oike: a basket of sandwiches, big burgers and hand-dripped coffee, to eat in or take away, Thursday to Saturday. About ¥1,100–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 18 March 2021 (Tabelog). Run by two sisters (July 2025 review) — "two beautiful sisters", in that reviewer's words; two women run it (September 2025 review). Shop T-shirts and goods are sold; updates on Instagram (July 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 fan, first here after a Kitri concert in 2022, had a bar in Tokyo name a cocktail "BUNNY b." after the shop.
A June 2026 visitor in the area for medical appointments got the last seat for a big burger as others took food away.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BUNNY b.、ハンバーガー・サンドイッチ、中京区堺町通押小路上がる竹屋町162、9:45から、月・火・水・日曜休み、テイクアウト可、PayPay 可、2021年3月18日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 姉妹で営む、ティファニーブルーの店、かごから選ぶサンドイッチ2つと飲み物1,100円から、大きなハンバーガー、ホットドッグ、一杯ずつ淹れるコーヒー、夜のバーの営業は終了。

cultural_comfort.note: Small shop; takeaway available.

kyoto_yakiniku_gyurakutei.gf_detail: Ask. Cuts can be ordered with salt or sauce (April 2026 review); the sauces usually contain soy and wheat.
kyoto_yakiniku_gyurakutei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Oita wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_gyurakutei.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30); usually closed the third Wednesday; from 15:00 in November 2026 (17:00 on 29 November); closed 31 December–2 January (Tabelog). Two-hour seat limit (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「無し」). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 64 seats, all in private rooms (Tabelog). By Shijo-Shinmachi, 3 min from Karasuma or Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_gyurakutei.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo-Shinmachi] A busy, all-private-room yakiniku of whole Oita wagyu near Shijo-Karasuma, popular with regulars of 20 years and visitors alike: tongue platters, harami, misuji and a well-priced drinks plan. About ¥6,000–10,000.

chef_bio.background: Buys whole Oita wagyu and serves only cuts graded 4 and up (TableCheck; March 2025 review). A December 2025 regular has been coming for 20 years; celebrity autographs on the walls (May 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular of 20 years grilled four kinds of tongue in turn with onion sauce and declared the harami best.
An April 2026 couple, for whom it is a special place, found dishes out of order on a night busy with visitors.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都焼肉 牛楽亭、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、下京区、四条新町の東、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00、第3水曜はほぼ休み、2時間制、サービス料なし、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、64席、全席個室。TableCheck: 大分和牛を一頭買い、4等級以上。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): タンの盛り合わせ、ハラミ、本ミスジ、マッコリ、プレミアムロース、ユッケ、20年通う常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (2025–26 reviews).

kyoto_brisa_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Paella is rice-based, and salads and ajillo may suit (2025–26 reviews); ask about bread and stock.
kyoto_brisa_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetables are well cooked (February 2026 review), but the paella stock and most tapas use seafood or meat.
kyoto_brisa_teramachi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 18:00–24:00; closed Mondays and the third Sunday (Tabelog). Paella needs booking the day before; parties of 5 or more by phone only (Tabelog). Cover ¥200 a person (Tabelog Japanese original 「おつき出しとして 200円/人」). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats: 4 at the counter and 8 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Teramachi south of Nijo, 8 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog).
kyoto_brisa_teramachi.notes: [Spanish bar · Teramachi-Nijo] A cosy twelve-seat Spanish bar in a quiet Teramachi street, run single-handed by the owner: book the paella a day ahead, add ajillo and wine by the glass. About ¥5,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: The owner runs everything alone (May 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 guest, sent by a food-loving friend, was told to book the paella and found the wines well explained.
A February 2026 diner had the room alone at 6:30 pm for flounder salad, shirasu ajillo and a paella with a delicious broth.

cultural_comfort.note: Book paella a day ahead (Tabelog).

kyoto_toru_cafe.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: toast, roll-bread and baguette sandwiches, hot dogs, Napolitan and hayashi rice (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_toru_cafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg and ham sandwiches, cheese toast, hot dogs and cream with the coffee (2022–2025 reviews).
kyoto_toru_cafe.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 7:00–15:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; hours may change. Morning sets 7:00–11:00 from about ¥650 (May 2025). Food sells out by mid-afternoon and orders may stop around 14:00 (February 2024; December 2025). No reservations (confirmed by phone, October 2025). Cash only. 23 seats, counter at the back; non-smoking. Directly across from Higashi Hongan-ji, 4 min from Gojo Station.
kyoto_toru_cafe.notes: [Kissaten · Higashi Hongan-ji, a 7 am machiya café] A calm, retro-styled café facing the temple gates, opening at 7: hand-poured house blend, thick cheese toast or a baguette hot dog, with records and reel-to-reel tapes on the owner's vintage hi-fi. Morning sets from about ¥650. Cash only. Closed Wed and Sun; orders may stop around 2 pm.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a kind, calm older couple running the café (February 2024, July 2024, November 2025); in January 2023 the master was working alone. The vintage audio equipment and reel-to-reel deck seem to reflect the owner's taste (March 2022; November 2025).

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "I sat at the counter in the back, where a nostalgic array of audio equipment lined the wall. It wasn't just for decoration; at that moment, the open reel deck was actively in use."
February 2024: "It seems to be run by a kind couple… by around 2 PM on this particular weekend, most of the food items were sold out and new orders were being turned away."
December 2025: "I noticed that the person who came in after me was turned away because they stopped taking orders at 2 PM."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Toru Cafe、カフェ、下京区烏丸2-307 (住所の表記のまま)、五条駅から徒歩4分、月・火・木・金・土7:00〜15:00、水・日休み、予約不可 (2025年10月に電話で確認)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、23席、禁煙。口コミ (2022年3月〜2025年12月、英語): 東本願寺の真向かいの町家のカフェ、店主のオーディオでレコードやオープンリールの音楽、モーニング7〜11時 (ロールパンのセット650円、チーズトーストのセット740円、シナモンシュガートースト、バゲットのホットドッグ)、ハウスブレンド450円 (生クリーム添え)、ミックスサンドとコーヒー1,000円、ハヤシライス、ナポリタン、穏やかな夫婦が営む、午後は売り切れや14時ごろの注文終了あり、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Calm morning café; cash only; food can sell out by early afternoon.

kyoto_cafe_goryukaku.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pound cake, hot sandwiches and curry, and mitarashi dango with a soy-based sauce (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_cafe_goryukaku.vegan_detail: Ask. The menu leans on tofu and soy milk (soy-milk matcha latte, tofu-flavoured warabi mochi; September–October 2026), but cream soda, ice cream and pound cake are dairy and no vegan labelling is mentioned.
kyoto_cafe_goryukaku.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change. No reservations for the café. Self-service: order and pay at a ticket machine or tablet, then collect your order when your number is called; water is self-service (August–September 2026). Cards and QR codes; no e-money. Non-smoking. The café on the 1st floor is free to enter; the 2nd floor is shown on paid, bookable tours during special openings (September 2026). In a Taisho-era Western-style house on a side street off Kiyomizu-zaka.
kyoto_cafe_goryukaku.notes: [Café · Kiyomizu-zaka, tea in a Taisho villa] Step off the crowded slope into a quiet ground-floor café in a Taisho-era Western villa: stained glass, a tiled table, a fireplace, a courtyard fountain and Yumeji paintings. Cream soda, sweet-potato pound cake, grilled dango and curry; order at the machine. About ¥1,000–2,500. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2026) describe the café as occupying the 1st floor of the former Matsukaze family residence, designed by the architect Takeda Goichi and registered as a national tangible cultural property in 1999 (September 2026); the 2nd floor, with views of the Yasaka pagoda, opens for paid guided tours. The operator is not named in the sources; one reviewer noted the tofu-forward menu and that it stands among yudofu restaurants.
chef_bio.specialty: Café in a cultural-property villa; sweets and light meals.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "While the second floor requires an admission fee for viewing, the first-floor cafe is open to everyone without any entry fee… You can relax in a serene environment that feels completely detached from the hustle and bustle of Kiyomizu-dera."
September 2026: "As for the food… it was very tofu-centric! … my daughter struggled with the strong tofu flavor of the warabi mochi."
September 2026: "The service is self-service (you order and pick up via a machine), so if you're looking for a more classic atmosphere, I recommend…"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ五龍閣、カフェ、東山区清水寺門前2-239、清水五条から1,141m、月・火・木〜日11:00〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、禁煙。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): Takeda Goichi設計の旧Matsukaze家住宅 (1999年登録有形文化財) の1階のカフェ、入場無料、2階は有料の見学ツアー、ステンドグラス、タイル、暖炉、噴水、Takehisa Yumejiの絵、券売機やタブレットで注文するセルフサービス、クリームソーダ1,000円、さつまいものパウンドケーキと抹茶アイス、わらび餅、焼きたての団子 (みたらし・抹茶・きなこ)、いちごのかき氷、カレー、ホットサンド、Sarutahikoのコーヒー、豆乳抹茶ラテ、豆腐の風味が強いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at a machine or tablet; self-service; free to enter the café.

kyoto_sake_park_pinn.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried pasta as the starter, pastas, fritters, bruschetta and fried dishes (2025–2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_sake_park_pinn.vegan_detail: Not vegan: small plates of conger eel, karasumi, anchovy, lamb, duck, gizzards and soft-shell crab (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sake_park_pinn.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat and public holidays 12:00–22:00; Sun 12:00–20:00; closed Monday, plus irregular days posted on Instagram. Open from noon for daytime drinking. Reservations taken (Instagram also used, March 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR codes. A U-shaped counter around the kitchen; non-smoking inside, an ashtray outside. Assorted appetizers ¥1,000 (or ¥2,000 for two); most plates ¥480–880; drinks from about ¥700 (2026). Over 60 drinks: natural wine, sake, gin, shochu, craft beer. On Shin-Sawaragi-cho-dori north of Takeyamachi, 389 m from Jingu-Marutamachi.
kyoto_sake_park_pinn.notes: [Counter bar · Jingu-Marutamachi, noon drinking with creative small plates] A friendly U-shaped counter that opens at noon: natural wine, rare sake, gin and shochu with inventive plates — fried conger eel with karasumi, ceviche, lamb, Taiwanese fried chicken — mostly under ¥900. About ¥3,000–6,000. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: March–April 2026 reviewers call it the sister restaurant of SUMIYA PINN near Karasuma Oike (kyoto_sumiya_pinn in this guide), here open from lunchtime. Reviewers describe friendly women staff around the counter, many solo and women guests, and a menu that changes daily (2025–2026).
chef_bio.specialty: International small plates; wide drink list.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "I visited 'Sake Park PINN,' the sister restaurant of the popular bar 'SUMIYA PINN'… With over 60 types of beverages available, including natural wines, Japanese sake, gin, shochu, and craft beer."
May 2026: "Fried Kyoto bamboo shoots with prosciutto and basil sauce, Setouchi lemon cream pasta, and fried anago (conger eel) with asparagus topped with karasumi."
June 2026: "There were a few other solo drinkers, and I chatted with the staff occasionally while enjoying my food and drinks."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒パーク PINN、バル、中京区新椹木町通竹屋町上る西革堂町175-2、神宮丸太町から389m、火〜土・祝日12:00〜22:00、日12:00〜20:00、月曜休み、不定休 (Instagram)、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙、カウンター。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 烏丸御池のSUMIYA PINNの姉妹店、昼から飲める、コの字のカウンター、日替わりの多国籍の小皿、前菜の盛り合わせ1,000円、穴子の揚げ物とからすみ、自家製からすみとセロリ、ほたるいかとアボカドのセビーチェ880円、黒舞茸のフライ680円、ごぼうとゴルゴンゾーラのポテトサラダ480円、ラム、鴨、ソフトシェルクラブ、台湾の唐揚げ、瀬戸内レモンのクリームパスタ、60種以上の飲み物、飲み物700円台から。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seating; good for solo drinkers; book via Instagram or phone.

kyoto_harapeko_takeyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sponge cakes, tarts, scones, apple pie and parfaits with sponge and crunch (2026 reviews).
kyoto_harapeko_takeyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream cakes, custard, ice cream and clotted cream (2026 reviews).
kyoto_harapeko_takeyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Fri 11:00–17:00 (omurice lunch 11:00–13:00, then parfaits, cakes and afternoon tea); Sat, Sun and holidays 9:00–17:00 (breakfast 9:00–11:00, lunch to 14:00); last order 16:30; closed Monday and irregular days. Reservations taken online (seats or items such as cakes); cancellation fees apply on the day — no-show 100% of reserved items or ¥2,000 per person for seat-only bookings. 90-minute limit (February 2026). Cash only. 12 seats: 4 at the counter, 4 tables for two; non-smoking. A crepe vending machine outside (October 2026). West of the Takeyamachi-Fuyacho crossing, 7 min from Marutamachi.
kyoto_harapeko_takeyamachi.notes: [Sweets café · Takeyamachi-Fuyacho, bear parfaits and afternoon tea] A tiny, very cute café where a pastry chef builds bear-topped parfaits, cakes and afternoon teas, with omurice lunches on weekdays and breakfast at weekends. Parfaits about ¥1,800–2,400. Book online; 90-minute limit; cash only. Closed Monday. (Not the Hanamikoji udon shop of the same name.)

chef_bio.background: A February 2026 reviewer writes it began as a pop-up café in Shiga and opened here, in the Goshonishi area, in November 2025; a November 2026 regular marked its first anniversary and had followed it since its shared-café days. An October 2026 reviewer says it is run by a pastry chef; the bear character is called "Saburo" (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Sculpted parfaits; afternoon tea; homemade cakes.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "What I really want to emphasize is… this unbelievably cute presentation!!!!!!!!!! The ice cream bear gazing up at me is just too adorable!"

chef_bio.philosophy: Good water and nine generations of handed-down technique (official site).

kyoto_ottimo_ryogaemachi.hours_raw: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday lunch 11:30–14:00 (last orders 13:00) and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last orders 21:00); Friday dinner only; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays lunch 11:30–15:00 (last orders 14:00) and dinner; closed Tuesday and the second and fourth Mondays, with occasional extra closures (Tabelog). Coperto ¥330 a person (Tabelog, original コペルトとして、お一人様330円). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: 5 at the counter, 16 at tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray at the entrance (Tabelog). Often fully booked — reserve (April and June 2025). In a residential street near Karasuma-Oike (June 2026).
kyoto_ottimo_ryogaemachi.notes: [Italian · near Karasuma-Oike, fresh pasta] A small, homely Italian in a quiet street near Karasuma-Oike, known for its homemade pappardelle cacio e pepe buried in parmesan, its lasagna and generous lunch sets from ¥2,000. ¥330 coperto. Book — tables fill up. Closed Tuesday and the second and fourth Mondays.

chef_bio.background: No operator or chef details were found.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade pappardelle cacio e pepe; lasagna.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 repeat visitor upsized the cacio e pepe the second time round, cheese “like powdered snow”.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: オッティモ、イタリアン・パスタ、中京区両替町通二条下がる金吹町480 今人館 1F、月・水・木 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、金は夜のみ、土日祝日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・夜、火曜・第2・第4月曜定休、コペルト1人330円、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、22席 (カウンター5、テーブル16)、禁煙 (入口に灰皿)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 自家製の生パスタ、パッパルデッレのカチョエペペ、ペストのリングイネ、イカのアーリオオーリオ、ラザニア、パスタランチ2,000円 (前菜かスープ+500円、デザート+500円)、前菜・スープ・パン・パスタ・コーヒーのランチ2,500円、予約で満席になることも、烏丸御池近くの住宅街。

cultural_comfort.note: Small and busy; ¥330 coperto.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated March 2025 to June 2026.

kyoto_kakitani_sakaimachi.gf_detail: Ask. Oden in dashi, sashimi, fried rice and noodle soup; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kakitani_sakaimachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden with beef tendon, sashimi, crab and fried rice (reviews).
kyoto_kakitani_sakaimachi.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) Monday–Saturday; on Sundays and holidays open only for group bookings (Tabelog). Booking advised — tables fill with regulars (December 2024; February 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 22 seats: an 8-seat counter, a table for 6 and two raised tables for 4; smoking allowed (Tabelog). On Manjuji-dori east of Takakura, just off Karasuma-Gojo (Tabelog; March 2025). Birthday cake and champagne can be added to a banquet course for ¥5,000 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kakitani_sakaimachi.notes: [Izakaya · Manjuji-Takakura near Karasuma-Gojo, a regulars' haunt] A calm, old-style izakaya full of regulars: oden with the best simmered egg, Kujo onion and beef tendon, fine sashimi, and shibazuke or ume fried rice to finish. Counter seats for walk-ins if you are lucky; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: An izakaya reviewed since 2011 (Tabelog). A March 2025 reviewer heard that the previous owner ran a catering business; reviewers describe friendly staff and many regulars.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 walk-in got one of the last counter seats and drank a little too much with the regulars.
A March 2025 diner singled out the Kujo green onion in the oden, then noodle soup and ume fried rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かき谷、居酒屋、京都市下京区万寿寺通高倉東入ル堺町201-1、毎日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜・祝日は団体の予約のみ、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー不可、22席 (カウンター8、6人テーブル1、小上がり4人2)、喫煙可、宴会コースに誕生日のケーキとシャンパンを5,000円で。口コミ (2011〜2026年、英語): 常連の多い昔ながらの居酒屋、おでん (大根、煮卵、九条ねぎ、牛すじ)、刺身の盛り合わせ、蟹、れんこんの醤油焼き、まぐろとアボカドのわさび和え、にゅうめん、梅の炒飯、しば漬けの炒飯、先代は仕出し屋と聞いた、予約がおすすめ、1人4,000〜8,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars’ izakaya; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026. The official site (kakitani.net) did not respond.

kyoto_gion_take_french.gf_detail: Ask. French courses with house-baked bread, brioche and pastry; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_gion_take_french.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of fish, shellfish, lamb and duck, with butter (reviews).
kyoto_gion_take_french.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00 Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Service, charges and tax all included in prices (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). A 6-seat counter facing the chef; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). On Gion-machi Kitagawa (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_take_french.notes: [French · Gion north of Shijo, six-seat counter] A tiny French counter where the chef bakes the bread and desserts and plates intricate seasonal courses — a garden-like amuse-bouche, mackerel with onion espuma, duck confit in crisp skin. All-inclusive prices; lunch and dinner; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a personable chef who chats with guests across the six-seat counter and makes the bread and desserts in house.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 lunch for two sisters ended with the chef’s own bread and desserts.
A January 2026 New Year lunch opened with champagne, then crab, surf clam and flounder, and lamb.
A June 2026 diner was taken with an amuse-bouche arranged like a flower display.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 たけ、フレンチ・野菜料理、京都市東山区祇園町北側313-8、火〜日 12:00〜14:00、17:00〜22:00、月曜定休、サービス料・チャージ・税込み、カード可、電子マネー不可、6席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): シェフと話せるカウンター、パンとデザートは自家製、花のようなアミューズ、鯖のカルパッチョと玉ねぎのエスプーマ、鴨のコンフィ、山のアスパラ、桑の実、焼きりんご、2日寝かせたカンパーニュとブリオッシュに塩バター、リオレと和ハッカのアイスとホワイトチョコのエスプーマ、蟹・ホッキ貝・ヒラメの前菜と仔羊、シャンパン、1人8,000〜15,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Six seats; book ahead; all-inclusive prices.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_tokkyu_ramen_hiroshi.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat ramen noodles in a soy-sauce broth, and gyoza (reviews).
kyoto_tokkyu_ramen_hiroshi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broth with pork fat, chashu and gyoza (reviews).
kyoto_tokkyu_ramen_hiroshi.hours_raw: 11:30–21:30 Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter seating; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2026). At the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_tokkyu_ramen_hiroshi.notes: [Ramen · Higashiyama-Yasui, classic Kyoto shoyu] An old-school ramen shop at the Yasui crossing serving gentle, clear chicken-and-shoyu broth with back fat and soft noodles, plus gyoza and well-balanced chashu. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A long-established ramen shop at Higashiyama-Yasui (February 2024 review), reviewed since 2016 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a classic, unflashy Kyoto bowl and friendly service that even welcomes guests ordering only gyoza and chashu.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 drinker between bars was welcomed for just gyoza and chashu.
A January 2026 diner had a bowl within five minutes and found the clear broth gentle and comforting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 特級ラーメン 寛、ラーメン・餃子、京都市東山区毘沙門町30-4、月・火・木〜日 11:30〜21:30、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、禁煙。口コミ (2016〜2026年、英語): 東山安井の交差点、背脂の京都の醤油ラーメンの老舗、澄んだ鶏のスープ、やわらかめの昔ながらの麺、餃子、赤身と脂のバランスのよいチャーシュー、つまみだけでも快く、コスパがよい。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through January 2026.

kyoto_yanaginobamba_umenoi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled eel with a soy-based tare handed down since the founding, and dashimaki; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_yanaginobamba_umenoi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (official site).
kyoto_yanaginobamba_umenoi.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–20:00 (last order 19:30); closed Tuesday, plus listed extra days — in November 2026 the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 25th (official site). Tabelog gives lunch only, 11:30–14:00. Ends when the eel sells out; a family business that may close without notice if someone is unwell (official site). Few seats — booked guests are seated first; reservations may not be taken in July and August (official site; July 2024). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Takeaway and delivery in boxed form; New Year osechi to order (official site). On Yanaginobamba north of Anekoji (official site).
kyoto_yanaginobamba_umenoi.notes: [Eel · Yanaginobamba near City Hall, Edo-style unagi for 90 years] A small family eel house that steams its eel Kanto-style before grilling — soft and light, glazed with a tare kept since the founding. Unaju, shirayaki and fluffy dashimaki; expect a 30-minute wait. Closed Tuesday; ends when sold out.

chef_bio.background: Serving Edo-style grilled eel for more than ninety years to regulars, tourists, school trips and overseas guests (official site). The building was rebuilt and reopened by 2024 (2024 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Eel from trusted wholesalers, prepared fresh each morning, finished with the tare handed down since the founding (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 regular praised the steamed-then-grilled eel and the slightly sweet house tare.
A September 2024 diner was won over by the fluffy dashimaki in a tiered box.
A June 2025 guest added shirayaki to the Kanto-style eel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 柳馬場 梅乃井、江戸焼き鰻の味を伝えて九十余年、常連から観光客、修学旅行生、外国の客まで、信頼できる卸問屋から全国の鰻、毎朝その日の分を背開きにして白焼き、注文を受けてから蒸してタレで付け焼き、30分ほどかかる、創業以来のタレは醤油の素直な美味さと上品な甘さ、昼の部11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、夜の部17:00〜20:00 (L.O.19:30)、売り切れ次第終了、席が少ないので予約の客を先に、家族経営のため臨時休業も、火曜定休 (2026年11月の店休日は3・10・17・24・25日)、持ち帰りと配達は折詰、おせち (三段重45,000円、二段重35,000円、一段重25,000円)、京都市中京区柳馬場通姉小路上る柳八幡町74-2。食べログ: 梅乃井、うなぎ・寿司、月・水〜日 11:30〜14:00、カード可、電子マネー不可、禁煙。口コミ (2013〜2026年、英語): 京都で鰻なら梅乃井、関東風の蒸してから焼く鰻、鰻一尾のうな重、白焼き、肝吸いと弁当のセット、お重のだし巻き、建て替えて席数が減った、7・8月は予約不可と聞いた。

cultural_comfort.note: Few seats; book ahead; ends when sold out.

existence.note: Official site with November 2026 closing days; Tabelog reviews through 2026.
